subject: Riverside Avenue Comcast Utility Relocation
overview: The City Council held a special meeting to review a Comcast grant of location petition prompted by the impending demolition of 65 Riverside Avenue. The council referred the petition to the next regular meeting while directing the utility and demolition contractor to establish a transition plan that avoids service disruptions.

items.title: Comcast Grant of Location Petition for 65 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Referred to the next regular meeting following discussion with city staff and Comcast regarding coordinating utility relocation to prevent service disruptions to commercial customers during building demolition.
